{"hindi_letter":"प्रिय राकेश शर्मा जी,

नमस्ते। आपकी शिकायत जिला उपभोक्ता आयोग, भोपाल में दाखिल करने की तैयारी हो रही है। आपके मोबाइल (कीमत 40,000 रुपये) की वारंटी मरम्मत सेवा केंद्र ने मना कर दी है, यह सेवा में कमी मानी जाती है।

ध्यान दें: आपकी शिकायत दर्ज करने की अंतिम तिथि 29 सितंबर 2026 है, इसलिए जल्दी मिलना जरूरी है।

कृपया अगली बार आते समय ये चीज़ें साथ लाएं:
1. मोबाइल की खरीद रसीद (बिल)
2. वारंटी कार्ड
3. सेवा केंद्र की जॉब शीट
4. अपना पहचान प्रमाण
5. अपनी सालाना आय का प्रमाण (जैसे आय प्रमाण पत्र या वेतन पर्ची)
6. अगर आप किसी विशेष श्रेणी (जैसे SC/ST, विकलांग, महिला प्रधान परिवार) में आते हैं तो उसका प्रमाण

यह जानकारी हमें यह तय करने में मदद करेगी कि आप मुफ्त कानूनी सहायता के पात्र हैं या नहीं। कोई भी वकील की सलाह हमारे वरिष्ठ अधिवक्ता द्वारा दी जाएगी।

सादर,
विधिक सहायता क्लिनिक","english_letter":"Dear Rakesh Sharma Ji,

Hello. We are preparing your consumer complaint for the District Consumer Commission, Bhopal, regarding the service centre's refusal to repair your mobile phone (worth Rs 40,000) under warranty. This is treated as a deficiency in service.

Important: The last date to file this complaint is 29 September 2026, so we need to meet soon.

Please bring these items to your next visit:
1. Purchase invoice/bill of the phone
2. Warranty card
3. Service centre job sheet
4. Your ID proof
5. Proof of your yearly income (income certificate or salary slip)
6. Proof of any special category (SC/ST, disability, woman-headed household, etc.), if applicable

This information will help us check if you qualify for free legal aid. Any legal advice will be given only by our supervising advocate.

Warm regards,
Legal Aid Clinic","next_visit_checklist":["Purchase invoice/bill for the smartphone","Warranty card","Service centre job sheet/repair receipt","Client's ID proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID)","Proof of annual income (certificate or salary slip)","Proof of any protected category status, if applicable (SC/ST, disability, etc.)","Any written or messaged communication with the service centre denying warranty"]}

parsed.english_letter:
Dear Rakesh Sharma Ji,

Hello. We are preparing your consumer complaint for the District Consumer Commission, Bhopal, regarding the service centre's refusal to repair your mobile phone (worth Rs 40,000) under warranty. This is treated as a deficiency in service.

Important: The last date to file this complaint is 29 September 2026, so we need to meet soon.

Please bring these items to your next visit:
1. Purchase invoice/bill of the phone
2. Warranty card
3. Service centre job sheet
4. Your ID proof
5. Proof of your yearly income (income certificate or salary slip)
6. Proof of any special category (SC/ST, disability, woman-headed household, etc.), if applicable

This information will help us check if you qualify for free legal aid. Any legal advice will be given only by our supervising advocate.

Warm regards,
Legal Aid Clinic
